is_anopheles.evidence: Studied field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. mosquitoes (An. arabiensis, An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s.) from Pitoa, Cameroon.

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and L1014S (L995S) mutations using hot oligonucleotide ligation assay (HOLA) (Page 4, Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 reports full kdr 1014 genotype counts (1014 L/L, 1014 L/F, 1014 S/S) for 154 mosquitoes broken down by species (An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., An. arabiensis).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae and pupae were collected from breeding sites in Pitoa, North region, Cameroon between June and August 2011 and reared to adults for testing (Page 2, 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field and laboratory study reporting original bioassay and marker genotyping data.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito samples were collected from June to August 2011 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field collection performed by the authors in Pitoa in 2011.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, bioassay results, and location details are provided in the main text and tables (Table 1, Table 2, Table 3).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated deltamethrin resistance intensity and LifeNet LLIN bio-efficacy in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from Pitoa, North Cameroon, collected in June-August 2011. Species identification revealed An. arabiensis (86%), An. coluzzii (12%), and An. gambiae s.s. (2%). Genotyping of the Vgsc kdr 1014 locus in 154 unexposed control mosquitoes identified the L1014F (L995F) allele at 34% frequency in An. coluzzii (13/19, all heterozygous) and 0% in other species, while L1014S was absent.
